class.name: ethercat_bridge/EthercatHardwareInterface
class.description: REAL SCAFFOLD ros2_control SystemInterface for a CiA402 torque-mode EtherCAT drive train. Exports position/velocity/effort state and effort command per joint, identical to mujoco_ros2_control/MujocoSystem's contract (see g1_description's ros2_control tag). Bus I/O (on_configure's master init, on_activate/on_deactivate's CiA402 state machine, read()'s TxPDO consumption, write()'s RxPDO production) is stubbed and logged, not implemented -- see README.md and INTEGRATION_POINTS.md.
